reviews.title: Good value!
reviews.comment: This CPU cooler is almost as good as the water coolers. The ryzen 7 5800x has never exceeded 60⁰c playing a very demanding game. I highly recommend this cooler to anyone who doesn't like the idea of a liquid cooled. For the price, it can't be beat.
